messages:
anya: seeing a spike of apiserver 502/503s in eu-west1 around GPU onboarding windows, first noticed ~09:10 UTC. pods stuck Pending and controller-manager leader flips a few times.
ops-bot: alert: apiserver error-rate high (5xx) — threshold breached in eu-west1 at 09:12 UTC.
anya: minimal change set — rolling gpu nodepool scaleup for a customer. I checked nodes, kubelet logs show a bunch of tcp resets to the proxy (ambassador) during image pull.
samir: can you paste the apiserver logs around a failure?
anya: paste below: ```E0309 09:11:34.123456 1 handler.go:85] "http: apiserver handler panic" err="write tcp 10.0.2.45:6443->10.0.3.22:53712: write: connection reset by peer" stack="goroutine 821 [running]:\n...\n```
maria: also seeing etcd commit latency bumped briefly to 120ms at 09:11, and kv write queue depth increased. might be correlated with the connect resets.
josh: half-open TCP to ambassador can cause behind-proxy clients to hang and then apiserver handlers hit timeouts. Did the NAT IP rotation for the nodepool happen during onboarding?
anya: yes — cloud controlplane (provider) rotated egress IPs for the new nodes to avoid limits; node egress went through new NATs at 09:09.
samir: that fits — new NAT path had a path MTU / middlebox causing FIN/RESET flapping for long-running TLS streams to ambassador. When the apiserver sees a burst of broken connections it backpressure-sheds and we hit controller-manager leader re-election.
infra-bot: incident-tracker: opened #INC-2026 for eu-west1 apiserver 5xx spike. assigned to @samir oncall.
maria: quick mitigation: bump envoy/ambassador upstream keepalive and reduce connection reuse TTL so half-open sockets expire faster. also increase apiserver handler timeouts from 60s -> 120s for this week to absorb transient resets?
samir: prefer not to change global apiserver timeouts yet. do quick fix on ambassador: set tcp_keepalive=30s and max_conn_age 60s, and add a rolling restart for ambassador in eu-west1.
anya: rolling restart started at 09:18 UTC — initial error rate dropped to baseline by 09:23. new metric: etcd commit latency back to 18ms.
josh: followup: need to ensure GPU onboarding path doesn't route through the provider NATs that have aggressive TCP middleboxes. maybe pin egress for nodepool or add passthrough route for control plane traffic.
maria: also saw a cost spike note: onboarding retries caused extra image pulls — customer consumed ~20% more egress in that window. finance flagged increased bandwidth for multi-customer scaleups.
samir: action items: 1) pin nodepool control-plane egress ips for GPU node onboarding in eu-west1 (short-term) 2) add envoy/ambassador keepalive/max_conn_age defaults to SRE runbook 3) create gating check for NAT path MTU / middlebox on onboarding flows 4) review autoscaler backoff to avoid tight re-enqueues during controlplane instability.
anya: will own item 2 and 3. josh can you validate egress pinning options with cloud infra?
josh: on it, pinging infra-private and cloud-provider.
infra-bot: note: scheduled a postmortem sync 10:30 UTC; added tentative attendees: anya, samir, josh, maria, platform-eng.
anya: thanks — leaving logs and dashboards in the incident ticket. :thumbsup:
